profile_text.body:
Microsoft is a for-profit public company, ticker MSFT, founded in 1975 and headquartered in Redmond, WA, USA. Its SEC CIK is 0000789019. For the fiscal year ended 2026-06-30, it reported revenue of $331,839,000,000 in a 10-K filing. The company's Power Automate page describes the product as automating workflows and business processes across apps, systems, and websites using AI, digital, and robotic process automation. A customer quote on that page says a process that used to take over 100 people to validate and standardize data can be managed by just a few people with generative AI and Power Automate.

Microsoft's AI products include Microsoft Copilot, embedded across M365, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure Machine Learning, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Agent Framework, Microsoft Designer, Microsoft Teams AI, SharePoint AI, Clipchamp AI, and Power Automate AI. Azure OpenAI Service provides OpenAI models in Azure regions with enterprise content filtering, Entra ID integration, and data residency controls. Power Automate AI is listed for enterprise workflow automation with Copilot integration, M365 data access, and DLP integration. Semantic Kernel is described as a model-agnostic orchestration SDK for .NET, Python, and Java, superseded by Microsoft Agent Framework in 2026. Microsoft Agent Framework is described as the successor to Semantic Kernel and AutoGen, a unified .NET and Python agent SDK with graph workflows and native MCP and A2A support.

Washington state law exposure data includes 114 entries for Microsoft. The company is named in two cases in U.S. District Court, S.D. New York: The New York Times Co. v. Microsoft Corp. and OpenAI, and Authors Guild v. OpenAI, Inc.
